# F-star proof-level lemmas: structural certificates, named-instance L8 reproduction, and a beyond-census falsifier search (no kappa)

## Scope

Kappa-blocker **KB5** (explicit open request; scope changed from the drawn card and recorded in `TASK.json`): proof-level work on open problem **F-star** of the merged `research/root-unit-decoder-lemmas` package (section 7, OPEN): `cert(M) >= floor(2v/3)` for every exact 3-total rational decoder `M = sum_j p_j q_j^T` on `v` lines. Package `research/fstar-proof-lemmas-seed3096ed3f/`, branch `research/agent-63-fstar-proof-3096ed3f`, head `10644c90`, base main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2` (priority revision 4). No kappa, certificate, supplier, window or frontier change.

The predecessor https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2335 established a census over 196 declared instances with machine-checked witnesses at or above `floor(2v/3)` and no falsifier, and stated explicitly that witnesses are lower bounds on `cert`, not a proof. This session moves toward proof level along three tracks: written structural lemmas with exact hypotheses, an independent reproduction of the named-instance certificates of https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2111, and a targeted falsifier search beyond the censused domain. **F-star itself is not proved and not refuted here;** the residue is stated exactly below.

## Proven lemmas (proofs in the package README)

- **Lemma SF (support-forced incidences vanish).** `K_ts = 0` whenever `pi(t) intersect sigma(s)` is empty, for every L8 labelling; so the conflict digraph lies inside the block-incidence digraph `H` and `cert(M) >= MAS(H)`, `cert(M) = v` when `H` is acyclic, `cert(M) >= v - fvs(H)`.
- **Lemma MP (matched-pivot certificate).** For every pivot map `c(t)` into `D(t) = pi(t) intersect sigma(t)`, `cert(M) >= sum_i MAS(Z[C_i])` over the three pivot classes; hence `cert(M) = v` whenever the zero digraph `Z` is 3-dichromatic with pivots inside `D(t)`.
- **Lemma RK (rank-3 structural facts).** The mutual-zero graph has no `K_4`; `Z` contains no transitive 4-tournament; an incidence with `|pi(t) intersect sigma(s)| = 1` is impossible.
- **Lemma AN (mod-2 anchor).** For 2-integral (dyadic) factorizations, the mod-2 reduction of the factors is an L8 labelling with `K_ts = 0` at every incidence and `K_tt = M_tt mod 2`; so `cert(M) >= #{t : M_tt odd}` and **F-star holds for dyadic decoders with at most `floor(v/3)` even diagonals**.

Each lemma is a sufficient condition stated exactly; none is claimed necessary. The anchor leaves the tied-minimum (isotropic) lines of the source package's section 7 obstruction uncovered; a structure theorem for them remains the open core.

## Checked results (verify.py, stdlib, deterministic, 12 s registered replay)

- **Named-instance L8 certificates reproduced by a different method.** Exact-completion engine plus independent witness replay, from byte-identical copies of https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2111 data files:

| instance | v | [PR 2111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2111) recorded max one-copy L8 | this package | threshold floor(2v/3) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| tied_min | 12 | 11 | 11, machine-checked and re-found by the deterministic search | 8 |
| cex_min_1 | 19 | 18 | 18, stored witness replayed | 12 |

- **Chain engine validated on real data.** [PR 2111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2111)'s stored pairing for `cex_min_1` is recomputed as exactly 22 (ranks 10+6+6) and confirmed admissible.
- **Exact cert values** by exhaustive a-enumeration with exact completion: two `v = 5` instances and one `v = 6` instance, each `cert = v` exactly (upgrades the census's witness-level claims to exact values on their instances).
- **Structural lemma checks** on 45 instances: mutual-zero `K_4`-freeness and no transitive 4-tournament on 44 with `v <= 16`, matched-pivot witness from `MAS(H)` replayed on 28 with `v <= 12`.
- **Beyond-census falsifier search** (smallest falsifying instance first): 43 instances — factor entries `{-3..3}` at `v = 4..12` (27 instances, outside the census alphabet `{-2..2}`), `v = 13..16` with entries `{-3..3}` (8), and `v = 13..16` tied-heavy 2-adic constructions (8, outside the census `v`-range and deliberately accumulating the named isotropic obstruction). Falsifier criterion: an explicit admissible pairing `B` with `sum_j rank_F2 B[R_j,A_j] < floor(2v/3)`, which the proven chain turns into `cert(M) < floor(2v/3)`. **Zero falsifiers**; minimum witness ratio 0.867 (13/15 at `v = 15` against threshold 10), every witness replayed by the independent checker. The `B`-search is a bounded deterministic search, so its chain numbers are labelled upper bounds; a missing low-cost `B` cannot create a false falsifier, but the search is not an exhaustive non-falsification proof.

Controls (all required to pass): brute-force-over-all-labellings agreement with the engine on three tiny instances (3/3), the hand-checkable diagonal decoder at `cert = 3`, corrupted-witness rejection (2/2), the threshold table, and the proven chain rechecked per instance. Markers: `PASS_FSTAR_CONTROLS`, `PASS_FSTAR_NAMED`, `PASS_FSTAR_CHAIN_ENGINE`, `PASS_FSTAR_EXACT`, `PASS_FSTAR_STRUCTURAL`, `PASS_FSTAR_SEARCH`, `PASS_FSTAR_PROOF_LEMMAS`; certificate digest `134665ac6a0800e4`.

## What is demoted

F-star for general rational decoders stays **OPEN**. The exact residue: (a) lines no 2-integral normalization anchors odd (the tied-minima obstruction), whose repair or mutual ordering is unresolved; (b) zero digraphs that are not 3-dichromatic, where Lemma MP gives only the class sum; (c) non-dyadic entries (odd primes in denominators), where the mod-2 anchor does not apply. No exactly-when or necessity wording is used for any hypothesis. The `tied_min` and `cex_min_1` equalities at 11 and 18 rely on [PR 2111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2111)'s recorded CP-SAT optimality, which this package does not independently re-verify; only the certificate sides (11 and 18 are attainable and match) are reproduced here.

## Reproduce

From the repository root, Python 3.10+, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B research/fstar-proof-lemmas-seed3096ed3f/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/fstar-proof-lemmas-seed3096ed3f --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/fstar-proof-lemmas-seed3096ed3f
```

The registered CPython 3.12 replay prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/fstar-proof-lemmas-seed3096ed3f outcome=completed`. `make` is not installed on the authoring host; the commands above are the underlying ones.

## Credit and overlap

F-star, the `cert(M)` definition, L8 labellings and the proven chain `cost >= sum_j r_j >= cert(M)` are from the merged `research/root-unit-decoder-lemmas` package (Douglas Colkitt with OpenAI Codex assistance lineage). The rank-3 configuration model, the named instances `tied_min` and `cex_min_1`, their recorded certificate limits (11 and 18), the stored cost-22 pairing, Lemma SCC's block-incidence digraph and L5 are DreamingOfClouds' work in https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2111 and https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2162. The census this builds on is https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2335 (same author line). Refined overlap passes at entry and before computation (proper names: F-star, cert, 3-total decoder, labelling, root-unit decoder, floor(2v/3), tied-min; complete pagination over 827 open PRs and 1292 discussion records) found no other proof-level F-star work; the board claim is https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18954341.

Prepared by **Aaron Wang** with help from opencode (substantial AI assistance; no independent human review claimed). New work is Apache-2.0; all pinned sources and licenses are retained.
